Parco Sempione — Milan, Italy

Relatively safer day Average night

In detail

Milan's largest central park, behind the Castello Sforzesco. Popular and well used by day — joggers, families, the Arco della Pace. Like most large city parks, it gets much quieter and less lit after dark, which is the ordinary reason to be more careful at night here rather than any specific documented crime pattern.
